decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (ADS/CBSC/503 Rev C (received 20/06/13), TSP/HFC/P2010/02A, ASD/CBSC/501 Rev A (received 16/05/2013), ADS/CBSC/514, ADS/CBSC/513, ABS/CBSC/512, ADS/CBSC/511, ABS/CBSC/510, ADS/CBSC/509, ADS/CBSC/507, ADS/CBSC/508, ADS/CBSC/505, ADS/CBSC/506, ABS/CBSC/504, ADS/CBSC/502, 573/01 (received 11/02/2011)
ADS/CBSC/501, 101.0/3a covering letter dated 9th March 2016. Received: 10th March 2016. Bat report dated July 2016. Received: 25th July 2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The playing pitches and clubhouse hereby permitted shall be constructed in accordance with the design and layout set out in the planning application drawings and Design and Access Statement and/or Sport England/Football Association Technical Design Guidance Notes unless otherwise agreed with the Local Planning Authority in consultation with Sport England.

Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the external surfaces of the hereby approved development shall be in strict accordance with the details submitted and approved under application reference 00507/Y/P3(4,9,13) dated 02/09/2016.
Condition : 5 - The hard and soft landscaping shall be implemented in strict accordance with the details submitted and approved under application reference 00507/Y/P3(5,17,18) dated 28/10/2016.
Condition : 6 - The fencing around the main football pitch shall be carried out in strict accordance with the details submitted and approved under application reference 00507/Y/P2(6) dated 12/12/2016

Condition : 7 - Notwithstanding anything contained within Schedule 2, Part 2, Class A of the General Permitted Development Order (or any amendment thereof), no gates, fences, walls or other means of enclosure other than as specified in the application shall be erected without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 8 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside of the following times 07.00 to 23.00 (Monday and  Sunday inclusive).

Condition : 9 - Prior to first occupation of the building the floodlighting as submitted and approved under application reference 00507/Y/P2(4,9,13) dated 02/09/2016 shall be implemented in strict accordance with those details.
Condition : 10 - Any permitted floodlighting shall not be used outside of the following times 16.00 to 22.00 daily.

Condition : 11 - Prior to first commencement of the development the proposed visibility splays, vehicle sightlines and relocation of existing signage shall be carried out in strict accordance with details submitted and approved under application reference 00507/Y/P2(11,12,14) dated 09/12/2016 and shall be permanently retained as such.

Condition : 12 - The site shall be managed in strict accordance with the car park management plan as submitted and approved under application reference 00507/Y/P2(11,12,14) dated 09/12/2016 and shall be carried out for the duration of the use of the site for the hereby approved use.

Condition : 13 - Prior to first occupation of the hereby approved development the vehicles charging points shall be implemented in strict accordance with the details submitted and approved under application reference 00507/Y/P2(4,9,13) dated 02/09/2016 and shall be retained as such permanently.

Condition : 14 - Prior to the first use of the site for the hereby approved use the cycle parking details as submitted and approved under reference 00507/Y/P2(11,12,14) dated 09/12/2016 shall be implemented and retained as such and shall not be removed or obstructed.

Condition : 15 - The local planning authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues.
Condition : 16 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the ecology report dated January 2013.

Condition : 17 - Prior to occupation of the development the boundary treatment adjoining Site of Nature Conservation Importance shall be implemented in strict accordance with the details submitted and approved under application reference 00507/Y/P3(5,17,18) dated 28/10/2016 and shall be permanently retained as such unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 18 - The hardsurfacing shall be implemented in strict accordance with the details submitted and approved under application reference 00507/Y/P3(5,17,18) dated 28/10/2016.
Condition : 19 - The scheme shall be implemented in strict accordance with the detailed surface water drainage scheme as approved under application reference 00507/Y/P2(19) dated 20/12/2016.

Condition : 20 - The long term monitoring and maintenance plan to deal with the risks associated with contamination of the site shall be implemented in strict accordance with details submitted and approved under reference 00507/Y/P2(20,21) dated 12/12/2016

Condition : 21 - The remediation strategy for contamination discovered on site shall be carried out in strict accordance with details submitted and approved under application reference 00507/Y/P2(20,21) dated 12/12/2016

Condition : 22 - No infiltration of surface water drainage into the ground is permitted other than with express written consent of the Local Planning Authority, which may be given for those parts of the site where it has been demonstrated that there is no resultant unacceptable risk to controlled waters. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 23 - Piling or any other foundation designs using penetrative methods shall not be permitted other than with the express written consent of the Local Planning Authority, which may be given for those parts of the site where it has been demonstrated that there is no resultant unacceptable risk to groundwater. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description: Variation of condition 8 to change the opening and closing times of the Sports Club to 07.00 to 23.00 (Monday and  Sunday inclusive) and condition 10 to allow floodlights to be used from 16.00 to 22.00 daily of planning permission 00507/Y/P2 dated 16/10/2015 for erection of clubhouse, covered standing area and seating area with provision of football pitches and associated parking
